`tokens.json` is an unchanged copy of `loams/sdks/fixtures/tokens.json`, inspected
at upstream commit `797b32f642b4b68dc4c54dcb81c2579409f7f8f3`, under the Loams
repository's Apache-2.0 license. It exercises the SDK runtime contract R4.

SHA-256: `0c361e62257c1aa3a4a396d630f4a289cc6380fa6d7f19d2a6187bc67cdeb48a`.

This crate vendors the corpus so standalone builds do not require an adjacent
engine checkout. Update it deliberately when updating the pinned SDK.
